findings.desc: CHK-015:edge:1 (matcher count bound is policy-resolved, not hardcoded): no fixture in red-w2d-rejection-matrix.mjs or the smoke validates the matcher-count bound under a policy with a DIFFERENT policy.maxMatchers value. Every other floor claim of this kind in the same story (rule-2 length/entropy floors in red-w2d-specificity-conjunction.mjs via a raised-minMatcherLen policy, the class registry in CHK-016 via a CUSTOM matcherClassRegistry, policyDigest content-sensitivity in CHK-010 via an otherPolicy) IS proven with a two-policy differential; only the CHK-015 count bound is proven solely against the frozen default (maxMatchers=8), so a hard-coded 8 in place of policy.maxMatchers would pass every committed test. The binder self-flagged this exact gap in its own evidence note.

CHK-012 read-only claim (packages/main/tests/red/red-w2d-command-readonly.mjs, packages/main/src/tasks/red-evidence-envelope-smoke.ts section 7): the handler doc comment on red_evidence_envelope_check (packages/main/src/handlers/red-evidence.ts ~line 349) asserts the command spawns no RED run and its only child processes are the W2b binding readers git rev-parse/git show. No committed test verifies this: the mechanism used (a per-file SHA-256 snapshot of .lattice/ taken before and after the call) can only detect writes under .lattice/; it does not intercept, mock, or otherwise observe child_process.spawn/exec/spawnSync calls, so a regression that caused the handler to shell out to run a test (e.g. code drifted toward the reserved-for-later runner leaf) would pass this regression undetected even though it violates the storys core before a run is ever spent safety property. Given this is the single most safety-critical claim of the whole command, the read-only regression should intercept/spy on child_process to positively prove no RED-run-shaped spawn occurs, not rely solely on directory-hash absence-of-evidence.

CHK-013:happy:0 literal intent text reads: red-evidence-envelope-smoke.ts listed in lattice.config.json validate.commands and lattice validate runs it successfully. The bound evidence (packages/main/tests/red/red-w2c-validate-registration.mjs) only statically enumerates dist/tasks/red-evidence-* on disk and cross-checks it against the validate.commands array in config; it never invokes the lattice validate command itself. CHK-013:happy:1 separately runs the smoke by direct node invocation (node packages/main/dist/tasks/red-evidence-envelope-smoke.js), not through the lattice validate pipeline. So no committed evidence in this story exercises the actual validate-pipeline invocation path (spawn args/cwd/timeout handling for this entry) end to end; the binder self-flagged this exact gap (lattice validate was not run for this binding). Registration-in-config + direct-invocation-passes only jointly approximate the literal intent, and this exact substitution pattern was previously used for the same reason in W2c (red-w2c-validate-registration.mjs), so it is a known, repeated, but still real gap against the literal command the intent names.
